scripts.dev:dump:ac-evo: bun run dev:proxy && concurrently "bun --env-file=.env.development --watch run server/index.ts --record=ac-evo" "cd client && portless raceiq bun run dev"
scripts.dev:dump:acc: bun run dev:proxy && concurrently "bun --env-file=.env.development --watch run server/index.ts --record=acc" "cd client && portless raceiq bun run dev"
scripts.dev:dump:iracing: bun run dev:proxy && concurrently "bun --env-file=.env.development --watch run server/index.ts --record=iracing" "cd client && portless raceiq bun run dev"
scripts.dev:dump:f1: bun run dev:proxy && concurrently "bun --env-file=.env.development --watch run server/index.ts --record=f1-2025" "cd client && portless raceiq bun run dev"
scripts.dev:dump:fm: bun run dev:proxy && concurrently "bun --env-file=.env.development --watch run server/index.ts --record=fm-2023" "cd client && portless raceiq bun run dev"
scripts.dev:client: bun run dev:proxy && cd client && portless raceiq bun run dev
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd client i18n:compile && bunx tsc --build client/tsconfig.json --pretty false && bunx tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.record:demo: cd playwright && PW_SERVER_SET=fresh DEMO_START_FRAME=28% DEMO_MAX_FRAMES=2700 bunx playwright test --project=record-demo
scripts.test:screenshots: cd playwright && E2E_SERVER_MODE=dev PW_SERVER_SET=seeded PW_SCREENSHOT_ONLY=1 PW_SEED_SCREENSHOTS=1 bunx playwright test --project=mobile-screenshots
scripts.test:e2e: cd playwright && PW_SERVER_SET=all bunx playwright test --project=fresh-install --project=tunes --project=tunes-unseeded --project=seeded-e2e --project=mobile-device --project=tablet-device
scripts.test:e2e:fresh: cd playwright && PW_SERVER_SET=fresh bunx playwright test --project=fresh-install --max-failures=1
scripts.test:e2e:tunes: cd playwright && PW_SERVER_SET=tunes bunx playwright test --project=tunes --max-failures=1
scripts.test:e2e:seeded: cd playwright && PW_SERVER_SET=seeded bunx playwright test --project=seeded-e2e --max-failures=1
scripts.render:demo: ffmpeg -y -framerate 60 -i /tmp/raceiq-demo-frames/frame-%06d.jpg -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 30 assets/demo-render.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -framerate 60 -i /tmp/raceiq-demo-frames/frame-%06d.jpg -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 32 -b:v 0 assets/demo-render.webm
